caseName: California v. Mono County Irrigation Co.
caseNameFull: State of California v. Mono County Irrigation Company
summary: Error to the District Court of Appeal, Third Appellate District, State of California.
attorneys: Mr. U. S. Webb and Mr. John T. Nourse for plaintiff in error. No appearance for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726.
